descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D9 · P3 · Daniela

旧的「从口述推断入院状态」代码还留在仓库（AC5 说要删）；问卷里产品名写 Round Companion，票里写 RoundAI

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-06/S18

思路 / Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S27 「问卷文案按规定：baseline 的问题和选项、Settings 反馈文字（只管 T6）」 Survey copy as specified: baseline questions and options, Settings feedback text (T6 only)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T6 Survey questions, answer options and copy are exactly as specified (baseline 6 questions and buckets; handoff follow-up question; …（TFA-94609 AC 1；TFA-94609 Spec 1；TFA-94609 Spec 2；TFA-94609 Spec 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh physician (make-session) with the baseline unanswered, so the card shows on the Hospital list

When Open the baseline survey from the card and read every question and option; close it without submitting. Open Settings and read the Feedback section

Then Baseline: the six Spec 1 questions and the bucket options. Feedback: 'How is RoundAI working for you? Your answers go to the pilot team. Please don't include patient details.', a 1-5 rating, 'What should change?', 'Send feedback'. The handoff follow-up question (Spec 2) is checked on screen in S07 and S08

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94609 AC 1 / Spec 1 / Spec 3 (T6, gated: a miss reports as Blocked, which is why it has its own scenario and masks no ungated requirement). Product name: 'Before RoundAI' and 'How is RoundAI working for you?' are knownGaps 'open: Q11' (main shows 'Round Companion', SettingsModal.tsx:285), so the difference shows in the report as a known gap, not as a silent pass

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S27 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94609 ready for pr

问卷文案除了产品名都和 spec 一致：app 里写的是「Round Companion」，TFA-94609 写的是「RoundAI」。

The survey copy matches the spec except the product name: the app says 'Round Companion' where TFA-94609 says 'RoundAI' ('Before RoundAI…', 'How is RoundAI working for you?').

依据：allure f5280aec-…-result.json; code-review lane, status known-gap. 12/12 Spec 1 / Spec 3 strings are present at e02167f, and B2 and F1 differ only in the name (SettingsModal.tsx:285). The matrix knownGaps mark this 'open: Q11'. T6 is gated on TFA-94609 (ready for pr, PR #86), so a miss would report as Blocked. Note: TFA-94513 AC 2 requires the sign-in screen to say 'Round Companion' (not 'RoundAI').

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。
